default_summary.markdown_formatted:
## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss potential business acceleration strategies and program offerings for Karlie Webster's leadership consultancy, The Culture & Leadership Collective.](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=199.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Karlie's business is well-positioned for growth, having achieved $500k revenue in its first full year](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=389.0)
  - [Key opportunities: develop scalable products, enhance lead generation through strategic partnerships, and create more marketing assets (e.g. pitch video, book)](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1111.0)
  - [Dent Global's Key Person of Influence program aligns well with Karlie's growth goals and values](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1111.0)

## Topics

### Current Business Overview

  - [Karlie transitioned from 25-year corporate career to consulting 2 years ago](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=211.0)
  - [Focus on culture and leadership development](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=235.0)
  - [Generated $500k revenue in first full financial year](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=389.0)
  - [Uses LinkedIn for marketing, posting weekly with focus on gifting information](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=284.0)
  - [Has part-time staff, aims for 1-2 full-time employees](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=402.0)
  - [Balances business growth with lifestyle/family priorities](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=413.0)

### Growth Challenges and Opportunities

  - [Current year seeing slower growth due to economic factors](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=473.0)
  - [Clients more cautious about spending on leadership/culture](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=473.0)
  - [Opportunity to diversify lead generation beyond LinkedIn](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=681.0)
  - [Need for more consistent inquiry and lead flow](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=668.0)
  - [Potential to develop more scalable, repeatable offerings](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2687.0)

### Marketing and Lead Generation Strategies

  - [Develop 3-5 minute pitch video explaining value proposition](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1202.0)
  - [Create a "social pitch" tied to impactful giving (e.g. through B1G1)](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1292.0)
  - [Implement quiz funnels for lead generation and nurturing](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1596.0)
  - [Write a book featuring leadership stories/interviews as marketing tool](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2913.0)
  - [Enhance strategic partnerships for lead generation (e.g. with recruiters, HR associations)](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2101.0)

### Product Development Ideas

  - [Create a standardized audit or "Phase 1" offering as entry point](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2687.0)
  - [Develop a leadership "playbook" as free giveaway/lead magnet](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=3063.0)
  - [Consider packaging services into more scalable, repeatable offerings](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2687.0)

### Dent Global Program Overview

  - [12-month program + 2 months free onboarding (Oct-Dec)](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=3447.0)
  - [Focus on developing 17 key business assets](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1111.0)
  - [Includes workshops, mentoring, community access](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=2786.0)
  - [Investment options range from \~$21k-$24k AUD](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=3626.0)
  - [Aims to help reach $1-2M revenue with team of 4-8 people](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=1037.0)

## Next Steps

  - [Karlie to review proposal and consider investment options](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=3929.0)
  - [Morgan to send detailed proposal and case studies](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=3977.0)
  - [Follow-up scheduled for mid-November if no decision made sooner](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=4004.0)
  - [If proceeding, aim to start onboarding in December for January program start](https://fathom.video/share/U5TUE3UbPBs3hjJZkLHDGXivsdeY7kM-?tab=summary&timestamp=4004.0)
